Let the numbers be \(28a\) and \(28b\), with \(\gcd(a,b)=1\).  
Their LCM is \(28ab\). Given the other two factors are \(12\) and \(15\),

\[
28ab = 28 \times 12 \times 15 \Rightarrow ab=180.
\]

But if the other two factors are \(12\) and \(15\), then \(\gcd(12,15)=3\neq 1\), contradicting \(\gcd(a,b)=1\).

So no such pair of numbers exists.

\boxed{\text{No such numbers exist}}
